purpose: Prevent premature consumption of sealed fold3/fold4 holdouts when no existing strategy candidate has survived its own development contract strongly enough to justify untouched OOS validation.

holdout_disposition.reason: No existing candidate is development-qualified under its frozen historical contract.

interpretation: No eligible first V2.9 OOS strategy experiment exists yet.
This is not a system defect and must not be repaired by weakening historical rejection rules or spending untouched holdouts on rejected candidates.
The correct next stage is candidate development using already-consumed research data only, under the evidence-anchored architecture retained after V2.8.10.
A new candidate must be materially distinct from the rejected pure-price routes and must be preregistered before any fold3 outcome access.
next_stage_constraints: Use only already-consumed folds0-2 and already-authorized historical evidence for candidate development.
Do not reopen or tune rejected V2.8.7-V2.8.10 candidates.
Do not treat V2.8.12R E eligibility or freshness as validated alpha.
Do not consume fold3 until exactly one materially new candidate, implementation binding, V2.9 preregistration, baseline, cost model, and development PASS rule are frozen.
Fold4 remains sealed until a future predeclared fold3 validation succeeds.
No Setup, First60, Episode, live, or brokerage execution authorization is created.
